text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I did it…… I ran properly…… Ehe, ehehehe……

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer, I feel like... I've finally 
gained a little bit of confidence~!

A woman of her word. That is proof of 
tremendous growth. And at the same time—
choice_data_list:
(The race performances are improving too, 
steadily.)

text_block_list.text:
She's handling the fast pace of a Senior 
graded race properly. At this rate...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you think... I can do this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Can I do it!? Head to the Senior-class GⅠ 
where Opera O-san is waiting for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Before you run with Opera O-san, isn't 
there an opponent you still need to 
defeat?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Did the heavens call, or did the Buddha 
call? Evil spirits, begone—Spinach-pocus!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If you want to run with Opera O-san, 
you'll have to defeat this 
Matikanefukukitaru first!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Fukukitaru-san? Aren't we kindhearted 
soul friends...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. However... there is a very deep 
reason behind this.

"I didn't quite get it, but 
Matikanefukukitaru seems to have her own 
logic behind it."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, it's settled! The stage for 
our decisive battle is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, the Arima Kinen! At the 
year-end Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Then, let's definitely go with the Kinko 
Sho!

Words quickly retracted. And so, the stage 
for the clash between the close duo was 
set for March's Kinko Sho.
